name: SAP Maintenance AI Alert — IW38 High Priority Orders

nodes.name: Schedule — Every 4 Hours
nodes.notes: Polls SAP every 4 hours. Change to 'hours: 1' for hourly or use a Cron expression like '0 6 * * *' for daily at 06:00.

nodes.name: SAP — Fetch High Priority Orders (IW38)
nodes.notes:
Calls SAP S/4HANA API_MAINTORDER_0001 OData API.
Priority 1 = Very High, Priority 2 = High.
Equivalent to SAP transaction IW38 filtered by priority.
Replace sandbox URL with your SAP S/4HANA production URL for live use.

nodes.name: Check — Any High Priority Orders?
nodes.notes: Only continues if SAP returned 1 or more high priority maintenance orders.

nodes.name: Code — Format & Structure Orders
nodes.notes:
Formats SAP OData response:
- Converts /Date(ms)/ SAP timestamps to readable dates
- Maps priority codes (1→Very High, 2→High)
- Maps system status codes (REL, CRTD, TECO...)
- Builds HTML table for email
- Builds plain-text summary for AI

parameters.name: message
parameters.value:
You are an expert SAP Plant Maintenance engineer and operations manager. Analyse the following high-priority maintenance orders from SAP IW38 and provide:

1. **Executive Summary** (2-3 sentences on overall risk level)
2. **Critical Actions Required** (bullet list of the most urgent items)
3. **Order-by-Order Risk Assessment** (for each order: risk level, recommended action, urgency)
4. **Resource Recommendations** (which work centers or teams to mobilise)
5. **Estimated Business Impact** if these orders are not addressed within 24 hours

Be specific, concise, and actionable. Use plant maintenance terminology.

SAP Maintenance Orders Data:
{{ $json.plain_summary }}

nodes.name: Claude AI — Analyse & Prioritise Orders
nodes.notes:
Claude acts as a Plant Maintenance expert:
- Assesses risk for each high-priority order
- Recommends specific actions
- Estimates business impact
- Identifies resource requirements

parameters.name: subject
parameters.value: ={{ $('Code — Format & Structure Orders').item.json.p1_count > 0 ? '🚨 URGENT' : '⚠️ ALERT' }} SAP Maintenance Alert — {{ $('Code — Format & Structure Orders').item.json.order_count }} High Priority Orders | {{ $now.format('DD MMM YYYY HH:mm') }} PKT

nodes.name: Gmail — Send Maintenance Alert Email
nodes.notes:
Sends rich HTML email with:
- Colour-coded subject (🚨 URGENT if P1 exists, ⚠️ ALERT otherwise)
- AI analysis and recommendations section
- Full orders detail table (red rows = P1, orange = P2)
- SAP source metadata footer

nodes.name: Airtable — Log Alert History
nodes.notes:
Logs every alert to Airtable for:
- Audit trail of all alerts sent
- Tracking alert frequency per plant
- Historical P1/P2 order trends

nodes.name: No Action — No High Priority Orders
nodes.notes: Workflow ends silently when no P1/P2 orders are found. No email is sent.

main.node: No Action — No High Priority Orders

meta.description: Polls SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance orders (IW38 equivalent via API_MAINTORDER_0001 OData API) every 4 hours. Filters Priority 1 (Very High) and Priority 2 (High) orders, runs Claude AI analysis, and sends a rich HTML alert email with order details and AI-generated recommendations. Logs all alerts to Airtable.
